    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = data[0]
    r = int(data[1])

    total_sum = 0

            pos = (col_idx + row_idx) % len(digits)
            row_digits.append(str(digits[pos]))
        print(' '.join(row_digits))
        total_sum += sum(row_digits)
    
    print(total_sum)
